question: Based on the number of chambers in the heart, select the odd one from the following.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Crocodile**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Crocodiles** are unique among reptiles as they have a **four-chambered heart**, similar to mammals and birds.
 
• Their heart consists of two atria and two ventricles, which allows for the **complete separation of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood**.
 
• Despite being reptiles, this advanced cardiac structure provides them with better efficiency in **oxygen transportation**, especially important for their semi-aquatic lifestyle.
 
• In contrast, other reptiles like turtles, chameleons, and frogs have a **three-chambered heart**, making the crocodile an outlier.
 
• This adaptation helps crocodiles remain submerged for extended periods by effectively utilizing oxygen stores.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Turtle**__

 __
 
• Turtles have a **three-chambered heart**, which consists of two atria and one ventricle.
 
• They are reptiles and share this trait with most other reptiles except crocodiles.
 
• Their heart structure allows for some mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood, which is sufficient for their metabolic needs.
 
 
 
• **Chameleon**__
 __
 
• Chameleons, like other reptiles (excluding crocodiles), have a **three-chambered heart**.
 
• They rely on this heart structure to support their cold-blooded physiology.
 
• Chameleons are known for their unique ability to change color and their independently moving eyes, but their cardiac structure is typical of reptiles.
 
 
 
• **Frog**__
 
 
• Frogs, being amphibians, have a **three-chambered heart**, consisting of two atria and one ventricle.
 
• Amphibians like frogs have a circulatory system that allows some mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood, which meets their energy demands.
 
• Frogs are poikilothermic (cold-blooded) and their heart structure is well-suited for their dual aquatic and terrestrial lifestyle.
